scope: Current Git-listed tracked/untracked project files plus frontend/.next and .scout/logs; private env and credential files are read only to derive exact comparison values, never published or scanned as artifacts.
excluded: Environment files except blank example, credentials, dependencies, browser caches, generated test traces and user runtime state.
limitations: Exact byte matching only; does not detect unknown credentials, encrypted/encoded values, rendered image text or content inside compressed archives.
Point-in-time file scan, not a Git history/object scan or an external provider access test.
Hash confirmation covers only the fourteen backend/scripts paths listed by the referenced checkpoint; it is not a full-tree equivalence claim.
No source, configuration or ledger changes and no provider/model calls were made.
